title: Copenhagen cryptogram (Schmeh Top 50 no. 23), slip found behind an 1835 portrait of a Danish general

documents.shelfmark: unknown (scan Danish-General-Cryptogram.jpg, Cipherbrain; original slip lost)

transcription.source: cipher.txt read here from the 614x147 px scan upscaled 4-6x; cipher_sw.txt is ShadowWolf's 25-symbol reading (101 tokens measured)
transcription.notes: Measured 107 = 103 symbols + 4 long strokes (sentence dividers); distinct 21 includes the stroke, 20 symbols in the merged reading. The two readings agree except for splits of dotted strokes and carets.

system.summary: Three lines of digits, letters, dotted strokes and carets (20 or 25 symbols); not a simple substitution of any of ten languages tested.

diacritics.note: Dots attached to strokes and to n may be diacritics or separate signs; both conventions tested.

system.notes: o always follows n; digits 4 and 5 never occur. Could be shorthand or private code rather than letters.

prior_solution.where: Schmeh's Cipherbrain posts and comments; Matthew Brown's Danish hill-climb also failed

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: simulated annealing with character 5-gram models in ten languages (solve.py)

solution.what: Transcribed the scan (20-symbol merged reading) and collated ShadowWolf's 25-symbol reading.
Symbol counts; o only after n, 'non' twice, digits 4 and 5 absent.
Simple-substitution annealing in ten languages under six reading conventions, both transcriptions.
Dotted strokes as word separators, scored with a spaced model.
103-letter enciphered passages: 12 of 15 recovered at 40 restarts; true text scores -1.4 to -2.1 per letter.
300-restart reruns on the strongest languages; ceiling -2.8 per letter, no better.

outcome.method_basis: Simple-substitution annealing in ten languages under several reading conventions produced nothing readable, while matched controls of the same length were solved.
outcome.notes: Closed from the only scan; needs the original slip, the painting's identity, or a non-substitution model.
